They are coached by [[Rick Pitino]], in his second year at the school, and play their home games at [[Carnesecca Arena]] and [[Madison Square Garden]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. The Red Storm had a breakout year under second year coach [[Rick Pitino]] to win both the Big East regular season and tournament championship, and got a #2 seed to the NCAA Tournament. However, they lost to #10 seed [[2024–25 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] in the Round of 32. ==Previous season== The [[2023–24 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|Red Storm]] finished the season 20–13, 11–9 in [[2023–24 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2023–24 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2024 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing in the
